name: Portfolio
description: Full-stack developer portfolio: pre-rendered React (Vite) on a Node.js + Express API with PostgreSQL (Neon). Live GitHub and LeetCode stats, a contact form emailed via Resend, a live brain map, a one-page resume builder and a Google Meet scheduler. The public part of the code; the resume builder and scheduler are private.

paragraphs: Full-stack software engineer building fast, reliable web & mobile products with the MERN stack, React Native and machine learning.
features: Immersive, engineer-themed UI — dark & light themes, a fluid type system and a 12-column layout that uses the full width of laptops and large screens.
Hero — the name decodes from binary (hover it to see the initials A D as 01000001 01000100), a 3D code-editor card with parallax layers, and a node network that reacts to the cursor.
Live data — GitHub commits/repos and LeetCode stats fetched server-side, cached, and shown with a "synced X min ago" indicator.
Scroll storytelling — cards unfold into place, headlines flip up and the tech ribbons react to scroll speed — all compositor-only CSS, with a full reduced-motion fallback.

Resume builder — /resume-builder/: three templates, a live preview that keeps the resume to one page, an ATS check (a score with tips, and which keywords of a job posting it has), and the PDF by email. Signing in with…

requirements.text: The resume builder, the call scheduler, sign-in and the admin view stay private, so this copy is for reading: it doesn't build on its own, and all rights are reserved (LICENSE).

Signed-in and admin routes check the session; HSTS and other security headers on every page, with a Content Security Policy that runs only the site's own scripts (its inline ones by their hashes, checked at every build), Razorpay's checkout and Google's sign-in button.
